title: Grateful Dead Live at Springfield Civic Center on 1973-03-28

ai_review.summary: A soaring Dark Star and other classic ’73 jams shine on a mixed‑quality audience tape that’s clear enough to enjoy despite occasional hiss and pitch quirks.
ai_review.review: The show is celebrated for its 31‑minute, space‑filled Dark Star (plus strong Cumberland Blues, Eyes of the World → Playing In The Band and upbeat TLEO moments), earning high marks from fans who call it one of the best ’73 performances.  The recording is an audience capture – not pristine, with some hiss, a slight pitch rise in Box of Rain, and occasional whistle noise – but many reviewers still rate it among the better audience tapes, noting that the instruments remain audible and the overall listening experience is rewarding.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the musical performance (average show rating ~4.6) while noting mixed but generally acceptable audio quality (average recording rating ~3.2). Weighted combination yields a solid 4.2‑star overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience tape with occasional hiss and a slight pitch rise; some sections sound weak or have whistle interference, but overall instruments are clear and the mix is surprisingly good for an AUD source.

standout_songs: Eyes of the World → Playing In The Band
show_quality.setlist_flow: Fans note a strong, flowing set with a marathon Dark Star at its center; the upbeat TLEO‑style numbers keep momentum while the long jams maintain an engaging, space‑y atmosphere.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar work on Dark Star is described as cosmic, arpeggio‑laden and among the best of 1973.
